chart.tableCaption: Revenue by type and MRR for each month
chart.empty: No issued invoices or MRR in this period yet.
chart.estimatedNote: Months without a monthly snapshot are rebuilt from today's contracts: their MRR is dotted (and marked with * in the table).

bridge.title: MRR movements
bridge.description: {months, plural, one {This month} other {Last # months}}: what added to and subtracted from MRR (before VAT).
bridge.net: {hasGrowth, select, yes {{amount} net ({growth}) in the period.} other {{amount} net in the period.}}
bridge.startHint: MRR at the close of the month before the period.
bridge.newHint: Clients who had no MRR (and nothing paused) and start paying every month.
bridge.expansionHint: Clients who were already paying and now pay more: price rises, new services or the end of a pause.
bridge.contractionHint: Clients who pay less without leaving: price cuts, cancelled services or pauses.
bridge.churnHint: Clients left with no MRR and nothing paused.
bridge.adjustmentHint: Differences between monthly snapshots taken with different data (e.g. a cancellation recorded with a backdated effect).
bridge.estimatedNote: Includes months without a monthly snapshot, rebuilt from today's contracts (* in the table).
